title: Browser Relay config
description: Plugin config persisted under plugins['browser'].* in ~/.pi/dashboard/config.json. Read by the server entry. The relay is OPT-IN: the manifest sets defaultEnabled:false AND this schema defaults enabled to false; enabling is a settings toggle. Per-profile SSO pairing tokens are writeOnly — the server strips them from every client-facing config payload (redactWriteOnly, spec browser-plugin-settings scenario F2).

enabled.description: Kill switch (distinct from the plugin toggle): when false the plugin stays loaded but relay routes answer 403 and live instances are closed synchronously.

defaultBrowser.description: profileDirectory used when connect is requested without an explicit profile.

allowMultipleInstancesPerProfile.description: When false (default), a second connect on a profile with a live instance gets 409 {reason:'busy'}; when true the relay allows concurrent instances on one profile (user decision under tasks.md 2.2b — both paths implemented; the connect logic honouring this flag lands with workstream 2c).

browsers.description: Per-Chrome-profile settings keyed by profileDirectory — the stable key from Local State → profile.info_cache, never the user-editable label.

token.description: SSO pairing token pasted from the extension's connect page. writeOnly: never served back to any client; redactWriteOnly strips it from every broadcast and GET.

zeroDialog.description: When true, connect appends &token= to the connect.html URL so Chrome skips its Allow dialog. Token mismatch, Reject and no-answer are indistinguishable and all surface as the 60 s connect timeout (504).

allowedDomains.description: Navigation guardrail, NOT a sandbox: Page.navigate / Target.createTarget to a host outside this list is denied. Exact host or leading-dot entry for subdomains (.github.com admits api.github.com). Empty = any host allowed.
